claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship City of New York, Thomas, Liverpool May 12, with
mdse and 791 passengers, to Saml Thompson's Nephew—all
well. Since May 30 had light NW winds and calms; May 30,
lat 43 30, lon 59 10, spoke brig W W Lord, from Falmouth for
New York.

Ship City of New-York, Thomas, Liverpool May 12, with mdse. and
791[?] pass. (all well), to Samuel Thompson's Nephew. Since May 30,
the C. of N. has had light SW winds and calms.
